title: Issue 33 - original conflict ledger: selected public source follow-up and owner-review candidates
scope: New research annotations only; original immutable 603 captures, oracle, 50-case audit and canonical scorer remain untouched. No current-product claims are promoted into canonical fields without source confirmation or an owner Locked decision.
method: Compared original GitHub conflict ledger quotes to independently available public roaster product-page text. Search/browser crawler copies can predate the latest live page. This is targeted public source review, not a new authenticated full 603 replay.
status_policy: An archived conflict status is never erased or rescored; current product URL may be reused, variants/harvests may rotate and original oracle cannot be overwritten. Only separately tested new runtime logic can change new import behavior.

entries.archived_conflict: Current archived product spec Brazil/Medium versus page SEO Mexico/Dark
entries.public_page_observation: Public page title identifies Decaf Medium Roast; body and explicit product specifications consistently identify Brazil, Medium and chocolate/graham cracker. Last search crawl was within weeks, but archived SEO inconsistency may persist in metadata.
entries.recommended_safe_behavior: Continue to show both incompatible original source readings in review unless current SEO can be proven stale/other-product or owner approves a narrowly scoped direct-spec-vs-SEO precedence rule.
entries.owner_question: When direct selected-coffee specification and current body agree, but selected-product SEO contradicts them, may exact product specifications override SEO instead of withholding?

entries.archived_conflict: Natural marketing description versus washed processing stages
entries.public_page_observation: Explicit steps include whole-cherry yeast fermentation, pulping, secondary fermentation, washing, drying and sugarcane decaffeination; nearby prose also calls its processing natural.
entries.recommended_safe_behavior: Preserve complete stage information. Do not equate the decaffeination method with primary post-harvest process, and do not force Natural/Washed choice without approved final-process precedence.
entries.owner_question: For staged coffees that begin as whole cherry but are pulped and washed, should canonical process follow the final post-harvest washed stage or remain Other/Unknown?

entries.archived_conflict: Rotating offering source lists Peru, Mexico and Honduras
entries.public_page_observation: Page narrative still mentions a current Peru coffee while an explicit 'Current Decaf Coffee' specification names Mexico; historical product endpoint listed Honduras.
entries.recommended_safe_behavior: Keep conflicting origin blank for unconfirmed lot; show source alternatives and request current roaster/bag/release confirmation, never cache an old country as stable identity.
entries.owner_question: Should an explicitly rotating coffee require the member to confirm the current origin before any origin is saved?

entries.archived_conflict: Product structured facts Lempira versus SEO/story Parainema
entries.public_page_observation: Public product offers selectable Light and Medium-dark roast variants; the cultivar/lot remains unresolved by the available page text.
entries.recommended_safe_behavior: Never assign a roast level without knowing which variant the member selected; require current lot evidence for botanical varietal.
entries.owner_question: No new rule needed for withholding mismatched cultivars until the producer confirms the specific lot.

entries.archived_conflict: Explicit Notes Rich/Earth/Spice versus incidental chocolate/vanilla/spice prose
entries.public_page_observation: Published direct 'Notes' list and separate descriptive sentence still coexist.
entries.recommended_safe_behavior: Apply existing October 26 explicit-selected-coffee Notes outrank incidental prose rule; this source does not require an additional owner decision. Keep original frozen ledger case unchanged.

entries.coffee: Cortez - archived El Salvador Santa Ana
entries.archived_conflict: Old archived URL carried El Salvador roast and processing station contradictions
entries.public_page_observation: Accessible page at same old URL is titled Papua New Guinea Highlands and describes Eastern Highlands, a medium roast and Lahamenegu wet mill; the slug remains an old El Salvador copy.
entries.recommended_safe_behavior: Treat this as a different current product unless the live official catalog proves otherwise; never reuse or auto-update an old El Salvador coffee by matching only its historical source URL. Full current fetch/identity verification required.

entries.coffee: Stage Line - Brazil Capricornio Dulce Signature
entries.public_page_observation: Current source explicitly describes a blend of 50% natural yellow catuai and 50% honey mondo novo.
entries.recommended_safe_behavior: Retain both processing methods and proportions as component evidence; do not promote either alone to the single-valued canonical process. Existing Other/Unknown plus source details is safe.

entries.archived_conflict: Medium-Dark in current product description, Medium in a Chemex guide
entries.public_page_observation: Product summary describes Medium-Dark while separate How to brew text for Chemex calls it Medium. Product title/release consistent; roast descriptors differ.
entries.recommended_safe_behavior: Preserve both, and avoid deriving current espresso roast level from a filter-specific article without proof it is historical/generic.
entries.owner_question: May we disregard a contradictory roast adjective when it appears only inside a filter-brewing guide that does not describe the current espresso preparation?

benchmark_note: 21 prior exact gains and 3,090/90/822 baseline refer to already verified original603 source. Public-source case follow-up here does not change either count.
release_policy: No production publish, SQL, Edge, Auth, private member data or paid service. Any application change must pass exact-source CI and preserve concurrent Issue161.
